blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Charlotte Sales homered for the second straight day to lead the Philippine Blu Girls past Thailand, 7-0, in five innings on Tuesday in women’s softball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 at Anjo Softball Ground. Sales launched a two-run shot near the left field foul pole during the top of the third inning for a 5-0 lead to highlight a dominant showing by the Blu Girls at the expense of their fellow Southeast Asian rival.
